data.title: What Is the Crypto Clarity Act? What Tuesday’s Senate Vote Decides for XRP, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana
data.description: The Senate vote at 2:15 p.m. ET on September 15 could lock in permanent legal ground for XRP, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, or leave their commodity status resting on a document the next administration can erase overnight.
data.keywords: Solana, Commodity Futures Trading Commission, CLARITY Act, Ethereum, The Senate, Commission, Securities and Exchange Commission, Bitcoin, XRP, interpretation, Cynthia Lummis, CFTC, Getty Images
